nodes.text: Forty years. Not one gun drawn on this ground on Decoration Day, and I've buried men who wanted to. Eat something. Shoot for the beef if you must. Then go and let each of those four lie to you. I want to know which does it best.

nodes.speaker: whitcomb

nodes.speaker: whitcomb
nodes.text: The small carriers ask that too. One bad season can sell them to people in my own Compact who smile just the way I do. I know it. I haven't a rule for it yet. I'd sooner admit that than sell you a pig in a sack.

nodes.text: Colonel Brigg. You are the armed party who came down from the wreck. You have been of use to Sergeant Pritchard; I note it. The Dominion offers one thing: a road you may walk at night. Everything else people say they want comes after.

nodes.speaker: brigg
nodes.text: Old Wardens want local warrants and limits on requisition. Iron Command wants one order obeyed before any appeal. Both wear the old badge. Pritchard and I differ on what that badge permits.

nodes.speaker: brigg
nodes.text: A gate at each gap. A levy by head and wheel. Arms registered; militias under my command. I can patrol this road, not put a decent officer behind every desk. A bad one will have too much power. That's a price. I still mean to collect.
nodes.reason: Exact authored projection with original identities/current local context; all consequential effects remain ledger-acknowledged

nodes.speaker: brigg
nodes.text: Judge Quill hangs road-agents after a hearing, at noon, in public. Before there was a gate at the gap they were hanged by whoever caught them, or not at all. Tell me which you prefer and I will tell you what you are.

nodes.speaker: belden

nodes.text: Tomas Belden, Commonwealth provisioning. Take a bowl if you want; supper isn't a signature. Our stores can carry a town through a bad season. One list tells us where the need is. Somebody must answer for what it leaves out.

nodes.speaker: belden
nodes.text: Local provisioning crews want open counts and town appeals. Central stores insist on one office controlling release. That's an argument inside the Commonwealth, not a rumour from its enemies.

nodes.speaker: belden
nodes.text: A provisioning committee. It reaches people a merchant might never trust with credit. It also puts mistakes behind an office door. Ask to see your entry and who can correct it. I ought to have better answers than a committee's address.

nodes.speaker: belden

buttons.label: What does the landing tell us?

nodes.text: Don't touch it yet. Seven of these in six years. That makes eight. Left on the rail where anyone could find it. Someone wants an audience. I mean to find out who paid for one.
